title: CLI does not download with `HTTPS_PROXY`.
body:

### **Describe the bug**
When `HTTPS_PROXY` is set, `tauri init` does not successfully use the value. This can make the download of the Rust CLI fail, and therefore the entire `tauri init` fails.

### **To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Have a `HTTPS_PROXY`
2. Download the Rust CLI through `tauri init`
3. Notice that the Rust CLI fails to download through `tauri init` when needing to use `HTTPS_PROXY`
4. `tauri init` hangs :(

### **Expected behavior**
The CLI sucessfully downloads and installs like typical usages of `tauri init`.

### **Screenshots**
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3301043/126039586-3330b392-a189-4d4b-9ea7-65ed9e3ed19f.png)

### **Platform and Versions (required):**
<!-- Use `yarn tauri info` or `cargo tauri info` command to get this information, and paste it here: -->
```
Operating System - Windows, version 10.0.22000 X64
Webview2 - 91.0.864.70

Node.js environment
  Node.js - 14.17.3
  @tauri-apps/cli - 1.0.0-beta.6
  @tauri-apps/api - Not installed

Global packages
  npm - 7.19.1
  yarn - 1.22.10

Rust environment
  rustc - 1.53.0
  cargo - 1.53.0

App directory structure
/src
/src-tauri

App
  tauri.rs - 1.0.0-beta.5
  build-type - bundle
  CSP - default-src blob: data: filesystem: ws: wss: http: https: tauri: 'unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-inline' 'self' img-src: 'self'
  distDir - src
  devPath - src
package.json not found
```

### **Additional context**
This is a common problem in countries where a proxy is needed to access common resources. The screenshot and info comes from a chinese user that found this issue.

It seems that we do not pass the proxy information to dep `got`. https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/blob/e48bb3edff145018a88217432e21e4a7846fdf0e/tooling/cli.js/src/helpers/download-binary.ts#L42

The user says:
> Got may need to be like the following:
got('https://sindresorhus.com',{agent:{https:tunnel.httpsOverHttp({proxy:{host:'localhost'}}))}))
